technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Batch as the underlying batch processing framework for job execution.
Use Spring Expression Language (SpEL) for dynamic naming in U6.
Implement SQL execution via JdbcTemplate with support for multiple statements in U4.
Extend existing configuration classes to add new options for CodeGen, Merge, timeout, delimiter escaping.
Leverage Java 17 features (e.g., records, sealed classes) where appropriate for performance and clarity.
Maintain backward compatibility by ensuring new options are optional with sensible defaults.
Refactor MessageBus internals (U8) using profiling to identify bottlenecks; consider using concurrent data structures or batch processing.
assumptions: The existing codebase is based on Spring Batch and has a modular structure similar to Spring Batch Admin or Spring Cloud Task.
Development is performed by a single developer; no parallel work or code review by others.
All eight user stories are part of this single software increment and must be delivered together.
A functional test environment (e.g., H2 database, local file system) is available for integration testing.
Documentation will be updated in the project's existing user guide and API documentation.
Performance testing for U8 will be conducted to validate the optimization gains.

activities.activity_description: Review all user stories, design overall changes, identify common patterns, and define interfaces/classes to be modified or created.
Add configuration properties and logic to parameterize code generation options, e.g., via XML/Java config or command-line arguments.
Add configuration properties to parameterize merge options for incremental delta consumption with megastore.
Add a timeout configuration option to prevent jobs from running indefinitely; integrate with job launcher or step execution.
Create a processor or job step that can execute SQL statements or scripts using JdbcTemplate; handle multiple statements and script parsing.

activities.activity_name: Implement U5 - Custom RowMapper and ItemReaderFactory
activities.activity_description: Provide ability for users to supply custom RowMapper<Tuple> and extend NameColumnJdbcItemReader; implement the override of afterPropertySet to add timestamp and delete flag fields.

activities.activity_name: Implement U6 - Expression Support for Naming
activities.activity_description: Integrate SpEL to allow dynamic naming of directories/files based on runtime data (e.g., timestamp, intermediate fields).
Add an option to specify an escape character for delimiters in CSV output to ensure compatibility with Hive/HAWQ.
Analyze current MessageBus message transformation; optimize data structures, reduce object creation, and improve throughput (e.g., using batching, concurrency).
Write and execute unit tests for all new and modified classes; cover edge cases and ensure code coverage.
Set up test jobs exercising all new features; verify end-to-end behavior with realistic data and systems (database, file system).
Update user guide, API documentation, and configuration reference with new options and usage examples.
Review all changes for consistency, performance, and code quality; make necessary adjustments and clean up code.
